title: Mother's Day Classic 2026, Peppers Moonah Links
summary: The Peninsula's clearest active Mother's Day morning: a community walk-run at Moonah Links with 2.5km, 7km and 15km options before the lunch bookings take over.
description: Moonah Links hosts the Mornington Peninsula Mother's Day Classic on Sunday 10 May 2026. The event offers 2.5km, 7km and 15km walk or run options and raises funds for breast and ovarian cancer research. It is the strongest active Mother's Day option on the Peninsula if your family wants the day to start with something to do rather than just a table booking.
suitableFor: Families; locals; active couples; charity participants
editorVerdict: The cleanest active Mother's Day morning on the Peninsula. Do this if your family likes a day with an actual shape before lunch.
editorNote: Mother's Day often collapses into a single long meal. The Moonah Links Classic gives the day a better rhythm: move first, eat second, and let the rest of the afternoon soften naturally. The charity angle matters, but the real planning value is structural, it stops the day from becoming all booking and no momentum. If you are already heading south, this is the strongest way to begin Sunday.
